# Sanatana360 — Indian Heritage Knowledge OTT & Vedic Kids Gurukula

It features 200+ historical docu-series, 26 180+ page illustrated sacred Granthalaya e-books, real-time synchronized karaoke audio fables in 5 languages, ancient Mudra stress-relief therapies, Vedic mental math, and interactive spiritual instruments.

## 2. Sacred Mudra Vigyan & Neuro-Somatic Stress Relief
The 5,000-year-old science of Hastamudra bio-locks connecting the 5 cosmic elements (Pancha Bhootas: Fire, Air, Space, Earth, Water) to regulate the vagus nerve and reduce acute cortisol:
- **Apana Vayu Mudra (Mrit-Sanjeevani)**: Emergency panic attack and heart calm gesture; regulates erratic heart rhythm in 3–5 minutes.
- **Gyan & Chin Mudra**: Stimulates pineal and pituitary glands; ends racing overthinking and workday burnout.
- **Prana Mudra**: Activates Root Chakra (Muladhara), restores depleted Ojas, and cures chronic fatigue.
- **Shunya & Vayu Mudra**: Neutralizes spatial restlessness, dizziness, and nervous insomnia.
- **Hakini Mudra**: Synchronizes left and right cerebral hemispheres, maximizing cognitive clarity and focus.
- **Pranayama Integration**: 4-7-8 rhythmic breathing (Inhale 4s, Hold 7s, Exhale 8s) with interactive live timers.

## 3. Heritage Docu-Series & Ancient Science (200+ Titles)
- **Hampi (Vijayanagara Empire)**: 56 acoustic musical granite pillars, monolithic Stone Chariot, and geometric irrigation networks.
- **Konark Sun Temple**: 24 stone-carved sundial wheels calculating time to the second via shadow trigonometry.
- **Kailasa Temple (Ellora Cave 16)**: Top-down single basalt rock excavation carving 200,000 tonnes of volcanic rock without scaffolding.
- **Chola Imperial Navy**: 11th-century ocean-crossing naval campaigns across the Indian Ocean and Malacca Strait.
- **Iron Pillar of Delhi**: 1,600-year-old rustless forge-welded high-phosphorus iron pillar.
- **Nalanda University**: Ancient residential campus that hosted 10,000 students with a multi-story library of millions of manuscripts.
